basicContent.title: Our Services
basicContent.subtitle: We offer multiple ways to enjoy our cuisine

iconCards.title: Dine In
iconCards.longDescription: Immerse yourself in our restaurant's inviting atmosphere where every meal becomes a memorable experience. Enjoy freshly prepared dishes served by our attentive staff in a comfortable setting perfect for romantic dinners, family gatherings, or business meetings. Our cozy ambiance features carefully curated décor, ambient lighting, and a welcoming environment that makes every visit special.

iconCards.title: Takeaway
iconCards.longDescription: Skip the wait and grab your favorite dishes to go with our efficient takeaway service. Perfect for busy professionals, families on the move, or anyone who wants to enjoy our signature cuisine in the comfort of their own space. Pre-order online or by phone for quick pickup, with all meals carefully packaged to maintain freshness and flavor during transport.

iconCards.title: Delivery
iconCards.longDescription: Bring the restaurant experience directly to your home with our reliable delivery service. Our professional delivery team ensures your hot, fresh meals arrive promptly while maintaining the quality and presentation you expect. Available within our delivery radius with real-time tracking, contactless delivery options, and eco-friendly packaging that keeps your food at the perfect temperature.

iconCards.title: Wi-Fi Access
iconCards.longDescription: Stay connected with complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi available throughout our restaurant. Perfect for business meetings, catching up on emails, sharing your dining experience on social media, or simply browsing while you wait. Our reliable internet connection ensures seamless connectivity for all your devices, making our space ideal for both casual dining and productive work sessions.

iconCards.title: Accessible Parking
iconCards.longDescription: We provide convenient accessible parking spaces located close to our main entrance for guests with mobility needs. Our clearly marked accessible spots feature proper spacing and smooth pathways to ensure easy access to our restaurant. We're committed to creating an inclusive dining experience where all guests can comfortably visit and enjoy our services, with additional accessibility features available inside our establishment.

iconCards.title: Clean Restrooms
iconCards.longDescription: Maintain your comfort with our meticulously maintained restroom facilities that prioritize hygiene and cleanliness. Our dedicated housekeeping team ensures regular cleaning and sanitization throughout the day, providing a spotless environment with quality amenities, fresh supplies, and proper ventilation. We understand that clean, well-maintained restrooms are essential to your dining experience, so we maintain the highest standards of cleanliness and stock essential items like soap, paper towels, and hand sanitizer for your convenience and peace of mind.

basicContent.title: Frequently Asked Questions
basicContent.subtitle: Everything you need to know about dining with us

faqs.question: Do you accept reservations?
faqs.answer: Yes, we accept reservations for parties of all sizes. You can book a table by calling us at +44 20 7123 4567 or using our online booking system. We recommend booking in advance, especially for weekend dinners.

faqs.question: Do you offer vegetarian and vegan options?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! We have a wide variety of vegetarian and vegan dishes on our menu. Our chefs are happy to accommodate dietary restrictions and preferences.

faqs.question: Is parking available?
faqs.answer: Yes, we have a small parking area available for our customers. There's also street parking available nearby.

faqs.question: What are your opening hours?
faqs.answer: We are open Monday to Sunday from 11:00 AM to 10:00 PM. On weekends, we extend our hours until 11:00 PM.

faqs.question: Do you offer delivery services?
faqs.answer: Yes, we offer delivery through our own delivery service and partner with major food delivery platforms. Delivery times typically range from 30-45 minutes.

faqs.question: Can you accommodate large groups?
faqs.answer: Yes, we can accommodate large groups and special events. Please contact us in advance to make arrangements and ensure we can provide the best experience for your group.
